body:
@Sehun0819 If MatrixDiagV3 doesn't work due to type limitations, could you consider alternative approaches to achieve the desired functionality like tf.linalg.diag?
Thank you!

@sushreebarsa 
Hi! Even there exist alternatives this should be patched to avoid crash right?
Please check python version of [reproduction](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1R11FohcZZ-Ky1rpO-bJPOcztHdRIQE5R?usp=sharing).
```Python
import tensorflow as tf

tf.raw_ops.MatrixDiagV3(
    diagonal=tf.constant([0.0],dtype=tf.float32),
    k=tf.constant([1,2],shape=[2],dtype=tf.int32),
    num_rows=1,
    num_cols=1,
    padding_value=0.0,
    align='RIGHT_LEFT',
    name=None
)
```

Hi @Sehun0819 ,

Thanks for reporting. Here the checkfail is happening when the `diagonal` is of `rank=1` and `k[0] != k[1]` which needs to taken care. This is not problem with tensor type of `k` . 

You can try below code which works for `k `as tensor also.

```
import tensorflow as tf
tf.raw_ops.MatrixDiagV3(
    diagonal=tf.constant([10],dtype=tf.float32),
    k=tf.constant([1,1],shape=[2],dtype=tf.int32), // k=(1,1) also works
    num_rows=-1,
    num_cols=-1,
    padding_value=0.0,
    align='RIGHT_LEFT',
    name=None
)
```

Proposing a probable fix for this.

issue.title: Fix Checkfail in MatrixDiagV3

issue.body:
The Op raw_ops.MatrixDiagV3 terminates due to checkfail when the input `diagonal` is of `rank=1` and `k[0] != k[1]`.

This happens at this line below which is trying to access `diagonal_shape.dim_size(-1)` when rank=1 . Currently API will not work with Rank=1 and k[0] != k[1] due to this check fail.

https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/blob/e193d8ea7776ef5c6f5d769b6fb9c070213e737a/tensorflow/core/kernels/linalg/matrix_diag_op.cc#L241

Proposed a fix for same.

Fixes #62984 .
